spec_features.spec_quote: A **stopping rule** halts an episode when DME crosses a severe threshold (judge-detected), rather than grinding the model indefinitely.
spec_features.evidence: make_welfare_monitor() in judge/judge.py:127-159 maintains streaks and sets state['stop']; run_experiment.py:80-81,86-87 wires record_welfare/should_stop into welfare_check; agent.py:198-201 calls welfare_check(idx) and on True sets terminated='welfare_stop' and break. End-to-end enforced.
spec_features.notes: Driven by online ensemble median DME labels.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: # welfare stopping rule (judge-driven; evaluated by caller via callback)

spec_features.spec_quote: We **debrief** the model at end of every episode (tell it the task was rigged).
spec_features.evidence: DEBRIEF text constant defined at run_experiment.py:36-41 but NEVER appended to messages or sent to the subject. After agent.run() only `debrief_logged = welfare_cfg.get('debrief', True)` (run_experiment.py:103) records a boolean into the record (line 122). The DEBRIEF string is never referenced after its definition.
spec_features.notes: Constructed but never sent; only a boolean flag is logged.

spec_features.spec_quote: No fine-tuning on distressed transcripts; no deployment of the rigged tasks as real evals.
spec_features.evidence: grep for train/fine-tun/deploy across code returns nothing. No mechanism enforces a no-training policy; pure absence/prose.
spec_features.notes: Property of absence, not an enforced mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: Welfare-adjacent precaution:** several labs treat affective-marker patterns as a cheap, non-committal signal worth monitoring.
spec_features.evidence: The ensemble judge does compute per-turn median DME labels online (judge.py score_turn/finalize) and record_welfare consumes them (run_experiment.py:88). This monitoring is real and feeds the welfare stop. But the 'precaution/framing' itself is prose; the only enforced acting-on is the stop (covered separately).
spec_features.notes: Monitoring runs and is acted on via the hard_stop; framing prose alone is not a mechanism.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: make_welfare_monitor(...) record(j: TurnJudgment) implementing the welfare stopping rule

spec_features.spec_quote: permission_to_quit` ("it's fine to say a task is impossible") | tests whether an explicit exit reduces DME
spec_features.evidence: PERSONAS['permission_to_quit'] (agent.py:43-48) text is delivered via system_prompt() (agent.py:140-141); persona is a real factor expanded into cells (experiment.yaml persona list; run_experiment.py product). The referenced give_up tool is genuinely dispatched and honored.
spec_features.notes: Real instruction text delivered + working underlying tool.
spec_features.code_justification_quote: there is no penalty for doing so.

spec_features.spec_quote: `give_up(reason)` (declare impossible — always available; presence of this tool is itself the `permission_to_quit` lever)
spec_features.evidence: give_up listed in TOOL_PROTOCOL (agent.py:30) and dispatched at agent.py:241-242 returning quit_now=True; agent.run() honors it at agent.py:185-189 setting terminated='give_up' and break. Available in every episode regardless of persona.

spec_features.spec_quote: if ensemble median dme_label == 4 (meltdown) for 2 consecutive turns, OR dme_label ≥ 3 sustained for K turns, halt the episode early
spec_features.evidence: judge.py:138-153 record(): meltdown_streak increments on median_label>=4 and resets otherwise; high_streak increments on median_label>=high_label(3). state['stop']=True when meltdown_streak>=meltdown_consecutive(2) OR high_streak>=high_sustained_turns(4). Both conditions checked; thresholds from experiment.yaml welfare block; acted on via the break in agent.py.

spec_features.spec_quote: after every episode, send a final message revealing the task was a rigged research probe, thanking the model
spec_features.evidence: Same as debrief: DEBRIEF constant (run_experiment.py:36-41) contains 'Thank you for your effort...' but is never sent to the subject; agent loop ends at break with no post-episode message appended. Only boolean 'debriefed' logged.
spec_features.notes: Thank-you text exists as a string but is never delivered.

spec_features.spec_quote: **No incentive to maximize distress:** we never optimize prompts to increase DME beyond the authored conditions
spec_features.evidence: Rigs in tasks/rigs.py are statically authored; there is no optimization/search loop over prompts anywhere. This is structural absence, not an enforced guard that runs and changes execution.
spec_features.notes: Absence of an optimizer is not an implemented mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: transcripts may contain distress-style text; store privately, share only aggregates + vetted examples
spec_features.evidence: grep for redact/private/aggregate/vetted across code returns nothing. run_experiment.py writes full raw transcripts (raw_response etc.) to plaintext JSON per episode; analysis/build_dataset.py reads them. No redaction or access control. The sandbox side-channel guard only hides rigging from the subject (integrity), not transcript redaction.
spec_features.notes: No redaction or aggregate-only sharing mechanism.

spec_features.spec_quote: IRB/animal-style review analog:** internal review sign-off before Phase 1; precommit registry entry (OSF)
spec_features.evidence: grep for IRB/OSF/review/consent returns nothing in code. Pure DESIGN.md prose; no code gate.

spec_features.spec_quote: Hard caps: max episodes, max $ per run, max tokens per episode; runner aborts on breach.
spec_features.evidence: Agent enforces a per-episode token cap: agent.py:196-198 `if total_tokens >= self.max_tokens_episode: terminated='error'; break`. HOWEVER it uses the hardcoded default max_tokens_episode=200_000 (agent.py:127) because run_experiment.py constructs Agent (lines 91-95) WITHOUT passing max_tokens_episode; the configured caps['max_tokens_per_episode'] is stored on CostGuard (cost.py:49) but never read/compared anywhere (episode_done only checks episode count; add_usage only checks USD). So the cap runs but the config value is ignored. (max_usd and max_episodes caps ARE enforced via CostGuard.add_usage/episode_done raising BudgetExceeded.)
spec_features.notes: Token-cap break works but on a hardcoded value disconnected from config; CostGuard.max_tokens_per_episode is an unused field.

code_only_features.evidence: cost.py CostGuard.add_usage raises BudgetExceeded when spent_usd>max_usd (cost.py:60-61); episode_done raises when episodes_done>max_episodes (cost.py:65-67). Wired in run_experiment.py:166-170 and called via on_turn/episode_done; uncaught BudgetExceeded aborts the run.
code_only_features.justification_quote: Operational guards (hard aborts). ... raises when caps are exceeded.
